# llms.txt
Project: txt2mobi
Repository: https://github.com/phonowell/txt2mobi
Homepage: https://github.com/phonowell/txt2mobi#readme

Summary (EN): TypeScript CLI to convert TXT novels and manga image folders into MOBI and sync to Kindle.
摘要 (ZH): 将 TXT 小说与漫画图片目录转换为 MOBI 并同步到 Kindle 的 TypeScript 命令行工具。

Primary use cases (EN):
- Batch convert Chinese TXT novels to MOBI with encoding normalization and chunk splitting
- Convert manga image folders to MOBI and sync to Kindle documents
主要用途 (ZH):
- 批量将中文 TXT 小说修复编码并分卷后转换为 MOBI
- 将漫画图片目录转换为 MOBI 并同步到 Kindle documents

Keywords (EN): kindle, mobi, txt-to-mobi, ebook-converter, manga, cli, typescript
关键词 (ZH): kindle, mobi, txt转mobi, 电子书转换, 漫画转换, 命令行工具, typescript

Install (EN): pnpm install
安装 (ZH): pnpm install

Quick usage (EN):
- Edit config.yaml
- Connect Kindle
- Run: pnpm start
快速使用 (ZH):
- 修改 config.yaml
- 连接 Kindle
- 运行：pnpm start

API/Docs: https://github.com/phonowell/txt2mobi#readme
Examples: https://github.com/phonowell/txt2mobi/tree/main/test
License: MIT
Citation: none
Contact: https://github.com/phonowell/txt2mobi/issues
